about: A Class B, C or D shelf's altitudes as the sectional writes them (the engine's airspace_shelf_label), for the 3D map's label at each shelf's top, held by the engine (engine/facade/tests/airspace_shelf_label.rs) and the web (features/plan/map/terrain/airspaceShelves.test.ts). FAA Aeronautical Chart User's Guide, 9 July 2026, VFR Terms and Symbols, Airspace (p. 16) and Airspace Information (p. 52): MSL ceiling over floor in hundreds of feet, SFC for the surface, T for a Class C ceiling to but not including the Class B's floor, a Class D's ceiling alone with a minus for to but not including. The limits as the planner sends NASR's Class Airspace volumes.
